result.line: Sender key of a private arb fleet (not a paid job): EOA calls its team's unverified executor 0x0418f780 with 0xe8d314f2 (Felix feUSD vs DEX triangulation), 1,104 attempts / ~4.2 d = 260/day; EOA is 17.5% of 2,693 Executed skims in 1.8 d (sample of 40 of 2,693); skim to owner 0x43637877 averages 0.18 USD/success (median 0.0296 USDC; fleet gross ~495 USD/1.8 d ~ 275 USD/day), gas 1,433,685 gas x 0.49-1.10 gwei = 0.04-0.10 USD/call, failed 206k gas ~0.01 USD; caller receives nothing - profit skims to the contract owner, own funds.
